desc: Ideation: select exact offline Hilbert/Mo + four-Fenwick approach, with block-precompute fallback if too slow.
Implement a complete Python prototype: fast parsing, coordinate compression, four Fenwicks, add/remove deltas, Hilbert sweep, and output.
Stress-test the prototype against brute force on random tiny cases, including X=1/Y=1, repeated values, and large values near 2e8.

Benchmark adversarial/full-grid query patterns and estimate BIT operation count; tune Hilbert/Mo parameters if needed (packed count/sum Fenwicks, precomputed deltas, empty-set guards, minimal Hilbert POW).
Fallback decision: block-precompute method deemed unnecessary — packed-BIT Hilbert sweep is within budget on PyPy; no code change required.
Finalize solution: clean code, verify stdout format, and confirm Python int/no-overflow assumptions (packing is lossless: sum < 2^45, count < 2^17; Python ints unbounded).
